items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know whether Norman wanted me to stay with the group or not.

ctx.x: You made those records with Lester in California in '45 I guess. That was for Norman Brands (PHONETIC) wasn't it?
Yeah. Yeah. Right after that I got sick so I didn't know whether Norman wanted me to stay with the group or not. I wasn't able to anyway. So that was that.
Oh yeah, you're thinking of the '56 date are you?
